newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores acquires C.R. Anthony.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores acquires C.R. Anthony.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said Thursday that it completed the previously announced acquisition of C.R. Anthony Co, a specialty retailer of private and branded apparel with 246 stores in southwestern and Rocky Mountain states.
As a result, Stage Stores said it increases its strong presence in small towns throughout the central United States to 577 stores.
The total value of the transaction, including assumed debt, is about $92.0 million, Stage Stores said.

About 3.61 million shares of Stage Stores common stock were exchanged for all of the outstanding shares of C.R. Anthony common stock, ,or 0.3992 shares of Stage stock for each share of C.R. Anthony stock, Stage Stores said.

The exchange ratio was determined using a formula based on the average closing price of Stage stock for ten randomly selected days out of a twenty trading day period ended June 19, which valued each share of Stage stock at $20.04 per share.
